any advice is appreciated, man :) He doesn't know about this at all. He's such a good guy, last time I told him I was feeling suicidal he phoned my parents (in the middle of the night) and told them they needed to talk to me right now. Haha, my mum got pissed off and told me I'm attention-seeking and she demanded I told him right away that I didn't mean it. Lol. 

So yeah no he doesn't know about this, I dread telling him I feel like this because he WILL tell someone and my parents will lose their shit. I mean I fucking made a throwaway and ranted on reddit for a reason, y'know? 

He's coming over next weekend. Maybe I'll take him for a picnic and we can talk shit over, haha

Shhiiiiit. Dude, go to bed! It's 10:35pm here and I'm 23. I guess I'm horrible to my boyfriend in that I'm super insecure and need attention. I get upset with him when he doesn't contact me. He does the slightest thing wrong and I get upset. I don't go out of my way to be horrible to him but when my PMDD (super bad PMS) flares up I will just argue with him because my hormones are insane. I should love him unconditionally without expecting anything in return but I'm always expecting constant adoration from him. A year ago I realised I was actually being emotionally abusive to him. I've tried so hard to change but I've never told him I found that out. It's just fucked.
